question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "subterfuge".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Candor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Subterfuge" means a deceptive trick or strategy used to achieve one's goal or avoid something unpleasant. (छल-कपट)
◦ Example: He used subterfuge to avoid answering the difficult questions.

 

• "Candor" means honesty and openness in expression, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्पष्टवादिता)
◦ Example: She spoke about her mistake with complete candor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Deception (छल): The act of deceiving someone — a synonym of subterfuge, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Ruse (चाल): A crafty trick used to deceive — a synonym of subterfuge, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Chicanery (धोखाधड़ी): The use of deception to achieve one's purpose — a synonym of subterfuge, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of subterfuge: deception, ruse, trickery, artifice, stratagem, chicanery.

 

• Synonyms of candor: honesty, frankness, openness, sincerity, forthrightness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

2. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Succinct (सारगर्भित)

3. Meticulous (सूक्ष्मता से काम करने वाला): Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (उपेक्षापूर्ण)

4. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Malicious (दुर्भावनापूर्ण)

5. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Cacophony."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Harmony.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Cacophony" means a harsh, jarring mixture of discordant sounds. (शोरगुल)

 

• "Harmony" means a pleasing and orderly combination of sounds or parts, and figuratively a state of agreement or accord. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सामंजस्य)
◦ Example: The choir sang in perfect harmony.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Dissonance (बेसुरापन) — a harsh, unpleasant combination of sounds; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Discord (विसंवाद) — a lack of harmony or agreement; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Din (कर्कश शोर) — a loud, unpleasant, prolonged noise; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of cacophony: melody, euphony, symphony, consonance, tunefulness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Indolent (सुस्त)

2. Austere (सादगीपूर्ण): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Ornate (अलंकृत)

3. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Solitary (एकांतप्रिय)

4. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला), Secretive (गोपनीयतापूर्ण)

5. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Imprudent (अविवेकी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "lachrymose".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Jovial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Lachrymose" means tearful or given to weeping; mournful in mood. (अश्रुपूर्ण)
◦ Example: The film's lachrymose ending left the audience in tears.

 

• "Jovial" means cheerful, good-humoured, and full of jollity, and is therefore the correct antonym. (हंसमुख)
◦ Example: The jovial host greeted every guest with a hearty laugh.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Mournful (शोकपूर्ण): Expressing grief or sadness — a synonym of lachrymose, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Doleful (उदास): Sad and dreary in expression — a synonym of lachrymose, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Sorrowful (दुःखी): Feeling or showing sorrow — a synonym of lachrymose, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of lachrymose: tearful, mournful, doleful, sorrowful, weepy, plaintive.

 

• Synonyms of jovial: cheerful, jolly, merry, genial, buoyant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Calm (शांत)

2. Zenith (चरम बिंदु): Nadir (निम्नतम बिंदु), Trough (गर्त)

3. Ameliorate (सुधारना): Worsen (बिगाड़ना), Exacerbate (बदतर करना)

4. Laconic (संक्षिप्तवादी): Verbose (वाचाल), Garrulous (बकवादी)

5. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Modest (सादा), Understated (संयमित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Evanescent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Enduring.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Evanescent" means quickly fading or disappearing; lasting only a very short time. (क्षणभंगुर)

 

• "Enduring" means lasting over a long period of time, and figuratively something that withstands the test of time. It is therefore the correct antonym. (चिरस्थायी)
◦ Example: Their enduring friendship survived decades of distance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Fleeting (क्षणिक) — lasting for a very short time; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Ephemeral (अल्पकालिक) — lasting for a very short time; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Transient (अस्थायी) — not permanent, passing quickly; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of evanescent: permanent, lasting, everlasting, persistent, perpetual.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

2. Nebulous (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Precise (सटीक)

3. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Merciful (दयालु)

4. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (उत्तेजित)

5. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Scarce (विरल)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "perfidious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Loyal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Perfidious" means deceitful and treacherous; guilty of betraying trust. (विश्वासघाती)
◦ Example: History remembers him as a perfidious advisor who betrayed his own king.

 

• "Loyal" means faithful and steadfast in allegiance, and is therefore the correct antonym. (वफादार)
◦ Example: The loyal soldier stood by his commander till the end.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Treacherous (कपटी): Guilty of betrayal or deceit — a synonym of perfidious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Faithless (बेवफा): Not loyal or trustworthy — a synonym of perfidious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Traitorous (गद्दार): Guilty of betraying one's country or cause — a synonym of perfidious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of perfidious: treacherous, faithless, disloyal, traitorous, deceitful.

 

• Synonyms of loyal: faithful, devoted, steadfast, trustworthy, true.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meager (अपर्याप्त): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

2. Tenacious (दृढ़): Weak (कमजोर), Yielding (नरम)

3. Opulent (वैभवशाली): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (दरिद्र)

4. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Rebellious (विद्रोही), Unruly (उच्छृंखल)

5. Vivacious (जीवंत): Dull (नीरस), Listless (उदासीन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Puissant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Feeble.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Puissant" means powerful or mighty, especially in military or political strength. (शक्तिशाली)

 

• "Feeble" means lacking physical or other strength; weak, and figuratively ineffective or lacking force. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कमज़ोर)
◦ Example: The feeble old bridge could barely bear the weight of a single cart.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Mighty (बलवान) — having great strength or power; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Potent (प्रबल) — having great power, influence, or effect; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Powerful (ताकतवर) — having great power or strength; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of puissant: weak, powerless, impotent, frail, helpless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Belligerent (लड़ाकू): Peaceful (शांतिप्रिय), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

2. Copious (प्रचुर): Scanty (अपर्याप्त), Sparse (विरल)

3. Malleable (लचीला): Rigid (कठोर), Inflexible (अनम्य)

4. Auspicious (शुभ): Inauspicious (अशुभ), Ominous (अशुभसूचक)

5. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सावधान), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "erudite".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Uninformed.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Erudite" means having or showing deep knowledge acquired through extensive study; scholarly. (विद्वान)
◦ Example: The erudite professor could quote classical texts from memory.

 

• "Uninformed" means lacking knowledge or information about a subject, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अनभिज्ञ)
◦ Example: His uninformed comments revealed that he had not read the report.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Scholarly (विद्वत्तापूर्ण): Relating to or showing deep academic knowledge — a synonym of erudite, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Learned (पढ़ा-लिखा): Having much knowledge acquired through study — a synonym of erudite, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Knowledgeable (जानकार): Well-informed about a subject — a synonym of erudite, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of erudite: scholarly, learned, knowledgeable, well-read, cultured.

 

• Synonyms of uninformed: ignorant, unaware, unlearned, uneducated.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Servile (दासतापूर्ण): Domineering (प्रभुत्वशाली), Assertive (दृढ़तापूर्ण)

2. Clandestine (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Overt (प्रकट)

3. Precarious (अनिश्चित): Secure (सुरक्षित), Stable (स्थिर)

4. Munificent (उदार): Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कंजूस)

5. Fastidious (नकचढ़ा): Careless (लापरवाह), Undiscriminating (अविवेकी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Encomium."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Castigation.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Encomium" means a formal or high-flown expression of praise; a glowing tribute. (प्रशस्ति)

 

• "Castigation" means severe criticism or reprimand, and figuratively a harsh rebuke meant to correct or punish. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भर्त्सना)
◦ Example: The minister faced public castigation for his careless remark.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Tribute (श्रद्धांजलि) — an act or statement showing gratitude, respect, or admiration; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Eulogy (स्तुति) — a speech or piece of writing praising someone highly; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Panegyric (प्रशस्ति-भाषण) — a public speech or text in praise of someone; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of encomium: criticism, condemnation, censure, reproach, denunciation.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Insipid (फीका): Flavorful (स्वादिष्ट), Interesting (दिलचस्प)

2. Trenchant (तीक्ष्ण): Mild (सौम्य), Vague (अस्पष्ट)

3. Ostracize (बहिष्कृत करना): Welcome (स्वागत करना), Embrace (अपनाना)

4. Vacillate (हिचकिचाना): Decide (निर्णय लेना), Persist (दृढ़ रहना)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (विश्वासी), Careless (लापरवाह)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "pusillanimous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Brave.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pusillanimous" means showing a lack of courage or determination; timid and cowardly. (कायर)
◦ Example: His pusillanimous response to the challenge disappointed his teammates.

 

• "Brave" means ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बहादुर)
◦ Example: The brave firefighter rushed into the burning building to save the child.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Cowardly (डरपोक): Lacking courage; easily frightened — a synonym of pusillanimous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Timid (भीरु): Showing a lack of courage or confidence — a synonym of pusillanimous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Fainthearted (कमज़ोर दिल वाला): Lacking courage or resolution — a synonym of pusillanimous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of pusillanimous: cowardly, timid, fainthearted, spineless, craven.

 

• Synonyms of brave: courageous, bold, valiant, fearless, gallant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rustic (ग्रामीण): Urban (शहरी), Sophisticated (परिष्कृत)

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Naive (भोला)

3. Turgid (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Simple (सरल), Plain (सादा)

4. Abstemious (संयमी): Gluttonous (पेटू), Indulgent (भोगविलासी)

5. Rancorous (द्वेषपूर्ण): Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Friendly (मित्रतापूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Obdurate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Yielding.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obdurate" means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action; hardened in feeling. (हठी)

 

• "Yielding" means readily giving way to pressure or persuasion, and figuratively flexible and compliant in nature. It is therefore the correct antonym. (लचीला)
◦ Example: Despite the pressure, she remained gentle and yielding in the negotiation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Stubborn (जिद्दी) — having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Inflexible (कठोर) — unwilling to change or adapt; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 4: Adamant (अटल) — refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of obdurate: flexible, compliant, docile, amenable, tractable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diffident (संकोची): Confident (आत्मविश्वासी), Bold (साहसी)

2. Salubrious (स्वास्थ्यकर): Unhealthy (अस्वस्थकर), Noxious (हानिकारक)

3. Tumultuous (उथल-पुथल भरा): Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Calm (शांत)

4. Vapid (नीरस): Interesting (रोचक), Lively (जीवंत)

5. Innocuous (हानिरहित): Harmful (हानिकारक), Toxic (विषैला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "refulgent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Dull.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Refulgent" means shining brightly; radiant and gleaming. (देदीप्यमान)
◦ Example: The refulgent moon lit up the entire courtyard.

 

• "Dull" means lacking brightness or shine; lacklustre, and is therefore the correct antonym. (फीका)
◦ Example: The paint on the old wall had turned dull and faded over the years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Radiant (चमकदार): Sending out light; shining brightly — a synonym of refulgent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Luminous (प्रकाशमान): Giving off light; bright and glowing — a synonym of refulgent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Resplendent (शानदार): Attractive and impressive through being richly colourful or shining — a synonym of refulgent, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of refulgent: radiant, luminous, resplendent, gleaming, brilliant.

 

• Synonyms of dull: dim, lacklustre, faded, lustreless, drab.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Frenetic (उन्मत्त): Calm (शांत), Relaxed (सहज)

2. Impassive (भावशून्य): Emotional (भावुक), Expressive (अभिव्यंजक)

3. Assiduous (लगनशील): Lazy (आलसी), Negligent (लापरवाह)

4. Recalcitrant (अवज्ञाकारी): Compliant (आज्ञाकारी), Docile (विनम्र)

5. Impecunious (निर्धन): Wealthy (धनी), Affluent (संपन्न)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lassitude."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Vigor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Lassitude" means a state of physical or mental weariness; lack of energy or enthusiasm. (शिथिलता)

 

• "Vigor" means physical strength and good health, and figuratively energy, enthusiasm, and active force. It is therefore the correct antonym. (स्फूर्ति)
◦ Example: She tackled the new project with great vigor and enthusiasm.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Fatigue (थकान) — extreme tiredness resulting from mental or physical exertion; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 2: Lethargy (सुस्ती) — a lack of energy and enthusiasm; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Option 3: Weariness (क्लांति) — extreme tiredness; a synonym in the literal sense.

 

• Other antonyms of lassitude: vitality, energy, liveliness, vigour, dynamism.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Garrulous (बकवादी): Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Taciturn (मितभाषी)

2. Bellicose (युद्धप्रिय): Peaceable (शांतिप्रिय), Pacific (शांतिपूर्ण)

3. Obsequious (चापलूस): Arrogant (अभिमानी), Haughty (घमंडी)

4. Parsimonious (कंजूस): Generous (उदार), Lavish (फिजूलखर्च)

5. Ductile (लचीला (धातु)): Brittle (भंगुर), Rigid (कठोर)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "cogent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Unconvincing.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Cogent" means clear, logical, and convincing; forcefully persuasive. (तर्कसंगत)
◦ Example: She presented a cogent argument that won over the entire panel.

 

• "Unconvincing" means not able to persuade someone that something is true or valid; failing to convince, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अविश्वसनीय)
◦ Example: His unconvincing excuse failed to persuade the panel.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Persuasive (मनाने वाला): Good at persuading someone to believe or do something — a synonym of cogent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Compelling (सम्मोहक): Evoking interest or attention in a powerfully irresistible way — a synonym of cogent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Sound (ठोस): Based on valid reasoning; logically solid — a synonym of cogent, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of cogent: convincing, persuasive, compelling, sound, forceful.

 

• Synonyms of unconvincing: unpersuasive, weak, implausible, dubious, questionable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Honorable (सम्मानजनक)

2. Truculent (उग्र): Docile (आज्ञाकारी), Gentle (सौम्य)

3. Effervescent (उत्साही): Dull (नीरस), Listless (सुस्त)

4. Mendacious (झूठा): Truthful (सच्चा), Honest (ईमानदार)

5. Insolent (उद्दंड): Polite (विनम्र), Respectful (सम्मानजनक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lassitude."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Vigor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Lassitude" means a state of physical or mental weariness and a lack of energy or interest. (थकावट या सुस्ती की अवस्था)

 

• "Vigor" means physical strength and active energy or enthusiasm, and figuratively reflects liveliness and robust health. It is therefore the correct antonym. (ओज, स्फूर्ति या जोश)
◦ Example: Despite his age, he approached every task with remarkable vigor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Lethargy (सुस्ती) — a state of sluggishness and lack of energy; a synonym of lassitude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Fatigue (थकान) — extreme tiredness after exertion; a synonym of lassitude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Languor (शिथिलता) — pleasant heaviness or lack of energy; a synonym of lassitude, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of lassitude: energy, liveliness, vitality, dynamism, vivacity.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Permanent (स्थायी), Eternal (शाश्वत)

2. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

3. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Secretive (गुप्त), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

4. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

5. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "opprobrium".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Honor.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Opprobrium" means harsh public criticism or disgrace resulting from shameful conduct. (अपमानजनक निंदा या कलंक)
◦ Example: The corrupt official faced widespread opprobrium after the scandal broke.

 

• "Honor" means great respect, esteem, or public regard, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सम्मान या आदर)
◦ Example: The soldier was treated with great honor for his bravery.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Disgrace (अपमान): A loss of reputation or respect — a synonym of opprobrium, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Infamy (कुख्याति): The state of being well known for a bad quality — a synonym of opprobrium, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Reproach (भर्त्सना): Expression of disapproval or criticism — a synonym of opprobrium, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of opprobrium: disgrace, infamy, contempt, ignominy, reproach, censure.

 

• Synonyms of honor: respect, esteem, dignity, prestige, glory.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (अंतर्मुखी), Solitary (एकांतप्रिय)

2. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

3. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (परिश्रमी), Industrious (मेहनती)

4. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Gloomy (उदास)

5. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (निरुत्साह)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Sagacious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Foolish.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Sagacious" means having or showing keen judgment and sound wisdom. (बुद्धिमान या समझदार)

 

• "Foolish" means lacking good sense or judgment, and figuratively reflects a lack of wisdom or careful thought. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)
◦ Example: It was foolish of him to invest all his savings without any research.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Astute (चतुर) — showing an ability to accurately assess situations; a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Shrewd (व्यवहारकुशल) — having sharp powers of judgment; a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण) — acting with care and thought for the future; a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of sagacious: foolish, unwise, silly, naive, imprudent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Vague (अस्पष्ट), Obscure (गूढ़)

2. Meticulous (सावधानीपूर्ण): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (ढीला-ढाला)

3. Novice (नौसिखिया): Expert (विशेषज्ञ), Veteran (अनुभवी)

4. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

5. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "turpitude".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Morality.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Turpitude" means depraved or shamefully wicked behavior; moral corruption. (नैतिक भ्रष्टता या दुराचार)
◦ Example: The court cited moral turpitude while dismissing the corrupt officer.

 

• "Morality" means principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong; virtuous conduct, and is therefore the correct antonym. (नैतिकता या सदाचार)
◦ Example: The teacher always emphasized morality and honesty among students.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Depravity (भ्रष्टता): Moral corruption or wicked behavior — a synonym of turpitude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Wickedness (दुष्टता): The quality of being evil or morally wrong — a synonym of turpitude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Corruption (भ्रष्टाचार): Dishonest or immoral conduct — a synonym of turpitude, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of turpitude: depravity, wickedness, corruption, vileness, immorality.

 

• Synonyms of morality: virtue, righteousness, integrity, decency, ethics.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quaint (पुराने ढंग का): Modern (आधुनिक), Fashionable (फैशनेबल)

2. Robust (मजबूत): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Solemn (गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Jovial (हंसमुख)

4. Tepid (गुनगुना (उत्साहरहित)): Hot (गर्म), Enthusiastic (उत्साही)

5. Utopian (काल्पनिक-आदर्शवादी): Realistic (यथार्थवादी), Practical (व्यावहारिक)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Incandescent."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Dusky.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incandescent" means emitting bright light due to intense heat; glowing or radiant. (तप्तदीप्त या चमकदार)

 

• "Dusky" means dark in color or lacking full light, somewhat dim, and figuratively suggests a lack of brightness or glow. It is therefore the correct antonym. (धुंधला या मटमैला)
◦ Example: The dusky evening sky slowly turned to complete darkness.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Radiant (दीप्तिमान) — sending out light brightly; a synonym of incandescent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Luminous (प्रकाशमान) — giving off light; bright or shining; a synonym of incandescent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Glowing (चमकता हुआ) — emitting a steady light without flame; a synonym of incandescent, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of incandescent: dark, dim, dull, lightless, gloomy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vivacious (जीवंत): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निर्जीव)

2. Whimsical (सनकी): Serious (गंभीर), Practical (व्यावहारिक)

3. Xenophobic (विदेशियों से घृणा करने वाला): Welcoming (स्वागत करने वाला), Tolerant (सहिष्णु)

4. Yielding (नरम (झुकने वाला)): Stubborn (जिद्दी), Resistant (प्रतिरोधी)

5. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निरुत्साह)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "reverence".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Contempt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Reverence" means deep respect and admiration felt for someone or something. (श्रद्धा या गहरा आदर)
◦ Example: The students bowed with reverence before their guru.

 

• "Contempt" means a feeling that a person or thing is beneath consideration, worthless, or deserving scorn, and is therefore the correct antonym. (तिरस्कार या अवमानना)
◦ Example: He looked at the cheat with utter contempt.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Veneration (श्रद्धा): Great respect mixed with awe — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Adoration (पूजा): Deep love and respect — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Homage (श्रद्धांजलि): Special honor or respect shown publicly — a synonym of reverence, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of reverence: veneration, adoration, homage, esteem, deference.

 

• Synonyms of contempt: scorn, disdain, disrespect, derision.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ample (पर्याप्त): Scanty (अपर्याप्त), Insufficient (नाकाफी)

2. Blunt (कुंद (स्पष्टवादी)): Sharp (तेज़), Tactful (चतुराईपूर्ण)

3. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Confusing (भ्रामक)

4. Deft (कुशल): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

5. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट वक्ता), Tongue-tied (हकलाने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Abrogate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Uphold.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Abrogate" means to repeal or abolish a law, right, or formal agreement officially. (निरस्त करना या रद्द करना)

 

• "Uphold" means to confirm, support, or maintain something such as a law or decision, and figuratively means to keep it in force rather than abolish it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बनाए रखना या समर्थन करना)
◦ Example: The Supreme Court decided to uphold the lower court's verdict.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Repeal (निरस्त करना) — to officially revoke or cancel a law; a synonym of abrogate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Annul (रद्द करना) — to declare invalid or void, especially formally; a synonym of abrogate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Revoke (वापस लेना) — to officially cancel a decision or law; a synonym of abrogate, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of abrogate: uphold, maintain, sustain, enact, establish.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fickle (चंचल): Steadfast (दृढ़), Constant (स्थिर)

2. Garrulous (बातूनी): Taciturn (मितभाषी), Reticent (कम बोलने वाला)

3. Haughty (घमंडी): Modest (विनम्र), Humble (विनयशील)

4. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सावधान), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण)

5. Jovial (हंसमुख): Morose (उदास), Gloomy (मायूस)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "incorrigible".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Reclaimable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incorrigible" means (of a person or habit) not able to be corrected, reformed, or improved. (असुधार्य या न सुधरने वाला)
◦ Example: The incorrigible prankster was sent to the principal's office for the third time this week.

 

• "Reclaimable" means capable of being reformed, recovered, or brought back to a good state, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सुधार योग्य)
◦ Example: Counselors believed the young offender was still reclaimable.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Irredeemable (अपरिवर्तनीय): Not able to be saved, improved, or corrected — a synonym of incorrigible, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Incurable (असाध्य): Not able to be cured or corrected — a synonym of incorrigible, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Hopeless (निराशाजनक): Admitting of no reform or improvement — a synonym of incorrigible, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of incorrigible: irredeemable, incurable, hopeless, unreformable, inveterate.

 

• Synonyms of reclaimable: reformable, correctable, redeemable, curable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lavish (शानदार (फिजूलखर्च)): Frugal (मितव्ययी), Stingy (कंजूस)

2. Malign (निंदा करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (तारीफ करना)

3. Nascent (उभरता हुआ): Mature (परिपक्व), Developed (विकसित)

4. Opulent (समृद्ध (वैभवशाली)): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

5. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (उत्तेजित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Pulchritude."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Ugliness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pulchritude" means physical beauty or attractiveness, especially of a person. (सुंदरता या रूप-सौंदर्य)

 

• "Ugliness" means the quality of being unpleasant or unattractive to look at, and figuratively is the direct opposite of physical beauty. It is therefore the correct antonym. (कुरूपता)
◦ Example: The story taught children to look beyond mere ugliness or beauty of appearance.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Beauty (सुंदरता) — the quality of being pleasing to look at; a synonym of pulchritude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Comeliness (सुडौलता) — the state of being pleasant to look at, attractive; a synonym of pulchritude, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Loveliness (मनोहरता) — the quality of being beautiful in an attractive way; a synonym of pulchritude, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of pulchritude: ugliness, unattractiveness, homeliness, hideousness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Querulous (शिकायती): Content (संतुष्ट), Uncomplaining (शिकायतरहित)

2. Rigid (कठोर): Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनीय)

3. Servile (चाटुकार (दास जैसा)): Domineering (हावी होने वाला), Assertive (दृढ़तापूर्वक)

4. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Courageous (निडर)

5. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Scarce (विरल)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "incessant".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Intermittent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incessant" means continuing without pause or interruption, especially something unpleasant. (अनवरत या लगातार चलने वाला)
◦ Example: The incessant noise from the construction site kept everyone awake all night.

 

• "Intermittent" means occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous or steady, and is therefore the correct antonym. (रुक-रुक कर होने वाला)
◦ Example: The region experiences intermittent rainfall throughout the monsoon.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Continuous (निरंतर): Happening without any break or gap — a synonym of incessant, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Ceaseless (अविराम): Never stopping or ending — a synonym of incessant, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Perpetual (चिरस्थायी): Continuing forever or without interruption — a synonym of incessant, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of incessant: continuous, ceaseless, perpetual, constant, unrelenting.

 

• Synonyms of intermittent: sporadic, periodic, occasional, fitful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Merciful (दयालु)

2. Wary (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

3. Abstain (परहेज़ करना): Indulge (लिप्त होना), Participate (भाग लेना)

4. Belligerent (आक्रामक): Peaceful (शांतिप्रिय), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

5. Capricious (चंचल (अस्थिर)): Consistent (सुसंगत), Steady (स्थिर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Piquant."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Bland.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Piquant" means having a pleasantly sharp or spicy taste, or agreeably stimulating and interesting. (चटपटा या तीखा)

 

• "Bland" means mild in flavor, lacking strong or distinctive taste, and figuratively means dull or uninteresting. It is therefore the correct antonym. (फीका या बेस्वाद)
◦ Example: The hospital food was extremely bland and lacked any flavor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Spicy (मसालेदार) — having a strong, hot flavor from spices; a synonym of piquant, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Zesty (चटपटा) — having a pleasantly strong flavor or quality; a synonym of piquant, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Pungent (तीखा) — having a sharply strong taste or smell; a synonym of piquant, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of piquant: bland, insipid, tasteless, dull, flavorless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Debilitate (कमजोर करना): Strengthen (मजबूत करना), Invigorate (स्फूर्ति देना)

2. Effervescent (उत्साही (जोशीला)): Dull (नीरस), Lethargic (सुस्त)

3. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

4. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संशयवादी), Shrewd (चतुर)

5. Hapless (अभागा): Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Lucky (सौभाग्यशाली)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "demur".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Agree.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Demur" means to raise objections or show reluctance and hesitation about a proposal or suggestion. (आपत्ति करना या हिचकिचाना)
◦ Example: Several board members demurred when the risky merger was proposed.

 

• "Agree" means to have the same opinion as someone, or to consent to a proposal without objection, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सहमत होना)
◦ Example: All the partners agreed to the new business plan without hesitation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Object (आपत्ति करना): To express disapproval or opposition to something — a synonym of demur, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Protest (विरोध करना): To express strong disagreement or objection — a synonym of demur, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Balk (हिचकना): To hesitate or be unwilling to do something — a synonym of demur, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of demur: object, protest, balk, hesitate, dissent.

 

• Synonyms of agree: consent, concur, accept, assent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Insipid (नीरस (फीका)): Flavorful (स्वादिष्ट), Interesting (रोचक)

2. Jaded (थका हुआ (ऊबा हुआ)): Enthusiastic (उत्साही), Fresh (ताज़ा)

3. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

4. Meager (अल्प): Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (पर्याप्त)

5. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Righteous (धर्मी)
